<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Introduction</h2><a id="user-content-introduction" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Introduction" href="#introduction"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Agents are being connected to production systems, but without a consistent identity and access layer around them: limited access control, no auditing, and no standard access restrictions. Metorial solves that.</p>
<p dir="auto">Metorial is a control plane for agent access to external systems. It sits between agents and integrations, handling auth, permissions, and observability in a consistent way. Instead of wiring integrations ad hoc, teams get a shared layer that standardizes how agents interact with systems.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Core Capabilities</h2><a id="user-content-core-capabilities" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Core Capabilities" href="#core-capabilities"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>1200+ integrations</strong> across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources, and custom MCP servers.</li>
<li><strong>Auth and token lifecycle management</strong> for OAuth, API keys, service accounts, and other credential flows.</li>
<li><strong>RBAC, SAML SSO, and IAM built in</strong> so agent access follows your existing security model.</li>
<li><strong>Scoped permissions</strong> per agent, workflow, team, or environment.</li>
<li><strong>Audit logs and traceability</strong> for agent actions, including which agent acted with whose credentials.</li>
<li><strong>Shared access patterns</strong> across teams and projects instead of one-off integration code.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Metorial for Developers</h2><a id="user-content-metorial-for-developers" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Metorial for Developers" href="#metorial-for-developers"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Metorial gives developers a single interface for connecting agents to real systems.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Use integrations across tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor without breaking security policies.</li>
<li>Expose integrations as tools to any agent framework.</li>
<li>Unify OAuth, API keys, and other auth flows into one magic URL.</li>
<li>Reuse connections across projects, environments, and people.</li>
<li>Avoid re-implementing integration and auth logic for every app.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">You write against one API, or use one connection URL, and Metorial handles the rest.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Metorial for Security</h2><a id="user-content-metorial-for-security" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Metorial for Security" href="#metorial-for-security"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Metorial provides structure and visibility into how agents access systems.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Centralized access control with RBAC, SAML SSO, IAM, and scoped credentials.</li>
<li>Clear permission boundaries per agent.</li>
<li>Audit logs for all actions, including which agent performed them using whose credentials.</li>
<li>Controlled sharing of integrations.</li>
<li>Consistent and secure credential handling.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">This makes agent activity enforceable and inspectable without relying on manual processes. Makes your Head of AI happy, lets your CISO sleep at night.</p>

<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>Create a setup session</strong>: Call <code>providerDeployments.setupSessions.create()</code> in TypeScript or <code>provider_deployments.setup_sessions.create()</code> in Python.</li>
<li><strong>Send the URL</strong>: Show the setup session URL to users so they can authenticate in their browser.</li>
<li><strong>Wait for completion</strong>: Wait for the setup session to finish and return an auth config.</li>
<li><strong>Use the auth config</strong>: Pass the auth config ID when configuring <code>providers</code>.</li>
</ol>
